title: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce - Business Studies - Advertising
exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Any paid form of non-personal presentation and promotion of ideas, goods, or services by an identified sponsor is defined as
questions.explain: **Advertising** is a key aid to trade that involves paying for media space or time to present and promote products, services, or ideas to a large target audience.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The primary function of advertising in a business organization is to
options: hide the product details from competitors
create public awareness and stimulate demand
transport bulky goods to the warehouse
questions.explain: Advertising solves the hindrance of information by **creating public awareness** about a product's existence, uses, and benefits, thereby stimulating consumer demand.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An advertisement designed specifically to convince consumers that a particular brand of toothpaste is superior to all other competing brands is an example of
questions.explain: **Competitive (or persuasive) advertising** attempts to persuade buyers to choose a specific brand over rivals by highlighting unique features or supposed superiority.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: When a government health agency broadcasts a message teaching citizens how to properly wash their hands to prevent a disease, it is using
questions.explain: **Informative advertising** is used primarily to educate the public, give instructions, or provide factual information without aggressively pushing for a sale.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An advert that promotes the consumption of a general product, such as "Drink Milk for Strong Bones," without mentioning any specific company's brand, is known as
questions.explain: **Generic (or mass) advertising** promotes a whole category of goods (e.g., milk, eggs, or beef) produced by an entire industry, rather than a single specific brand.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which advertising medium has the unique advantage of combining both audio and visual moving images to demonstrate exactly how a product works?
questions.explain: **Television** appeals to both sight and hearing, making it highly effective for demonstrating the physical usage and benefits of a product.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A major advantage of using the radio as a medium of advertising in developing areas is that it
options: provides high-quality printed color pictures of the product
can reach rural dwellers and illiterates through local audio broadcasts
allows consumers to touch and feel the physical product
is exclusively used for tracking international cargo ships
questions.explain: **Radio** relies solely on audio and is often broadcast in local languages, making it highly accessible to people in remote rural areas, including those who cannot read.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is a print advertising medium that is published periodically (e.g., weekly or monthly) and is usually printed on high-quality glossy paper with colorful images?
questions.explain: A **magazine** is a specialized print medium that offers excellent color reproduction and has a longer lifespan than newspapers, as readers tend to keep them longer.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All of the following are primary functions of advertising EXCEPT
options: increasing the sales turnover of a business
fixing the official exchange rate of the national currency
introducing new products to the market
questions.explain: Advertising educates, increases sales, and introduces new products. **Fixing currency exchange rates** is a macroeconomic function of the Central Bank, completely unrelated to advertising.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies
